body: Blocking R1-01 is still open: the round-1 commit (a19c068) only deleted blocking.md and changed state.json, and no code changed. `exitError` still adds the whole 2,048-byte stderr tail (stderrTailBytes, line 40) after the `browser could not start: the browser exited (<status>): ` prefix. `logText` (browser.go:93-111) then keeps the first 1,024 bytes and cuts the end. The newest stderr lines, which usually hold the fatal reason Chromium prints last (for example `Running as root without --no-sandbox is not supported` after DBus or GPU warnings), are dropped. That breaks FR-AMZ-BRET-005 ('with the browser's own reason'). Fix: keep the newest output. In `exitError`, drop the start of the tail so that prefix + status + tail fits in the 1,024-byte log budget, cutting on a rune boundary, for example with a leading `…`. Another option is to have `logText` keep the end of the text for browser exit reasons. The locked TC-006 subtest 'browser writing several lines' (browser_retrieval_test.go:604-615) only checks for `stub line`, so it passes either way. It cannot prove this case. Ask for a non-blocking follow-up test that requires the last stderr line (`stub line 40`) in the cause.

Blocking R1-02 is still open: the stray editing artifact `src/components/InformationModal.tsx.new` is still in the diff. It is a 35-line fragment that starts at `return (`, with no imports or function header. Nothing imports it, it is not valid TSX on its own, and it duplicates the body now in `InformationModal.tsx`. It is not part of the specification. Delete the file.

The documented failure line is `Amazon request failed url=… at=… status=… cause=…`, but `amazonGate.do` (internal/service/amazon_gate.go) logs `… cause=%s response=%s`. The rendered-page excerpt that follows the cause is not mentioned. An operator grepping or parsing the documented form may read the 2 KB HTML excerpt as part of the cause. Suggest documenting it as `… cause=… response=…` and saying that `response` is the start of the page Amazon returned.
